rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: Putin held a working meeting with the head of the Federal Tax Service, Mikhail Mishustin, proposed that he take the post of Chairman of the Government and, having obtained his agreement, submitted M. Mishustin's candidacy to the State Duma for consideration.
